questions.prompt: How many individual blades of grass are on a regulation soccer pitch?
reasoning: A regulation soccer pitch has an area of roughly 7000 square metres.
A square metre of dense turf contains about 350000 individual blades of grass.
Multiplying 350000 blades by 7000 square metres gives approximately 2.45 billion blades in total.

questions.prompt: How many grains of table salt are in a standard 750-gram cylindrical container?
reasoning: A standard teaspoon of table salt weighs about 6 grams and contains roughly 100000 individual grains.
Dividing 750 grams by 6 grams per teaspoon gives 125 teaspoons of salt in the container.
Multiplying 125 teaspoons by 100000 grains per teaspoon results in about 12.5 million grains.

questions.prompt: How many total kilometres do all the commercial aircraft currently airborne worldwide travel in one hour?
reasoning: At any given peak hour, there are roughly 10000 commercial planes airborne globally.
The average cruising speed of a commercial airliner is about 900 kilometres per hour.
Multiplying 10000 planes by 900 kilometres yields 9 million kilometres flown in an hour.
